info.title: VietGara API
info.description: Public REST/JSON API of the VietGara platform (API Specification). Generated from vietgara-proto.

tags.name: SettlementService
tags.description:
SettlementService manages settlements (FRD 3.8/3.9). Reads need
PERMISSION_BILLING_READ, changes PERMISSION_BILLING_WRITE.

tags.name: CatalogueService
tags.description:
CatalogueService manages the parts of a garage and the reference data
around them. Reads need PERMISSION_CATALOGUE_READ, changes
PERMISSION_CATALOGUE_WRITE.

tags.name: JobService
tags.description:
JobService manages the job catalogue (FR-CAT-05). Jobs are quoting data:
reads need PERMISSION_QUOTE_READ, changes PERMISSION_QUOTE_WRITE.

tags.name: CustomerService
tags.description:
CustomerService manages a garage's customers (FRD 3.4). Reads need
PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_READ, changes PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_WRITE.

tags.name: CustomerLinkService
tags.description:
CustomerLinkService links a garage's customer profile with a VietGara
user, with the user's consent (FR-CUS-06). Suppliers use their own link
in Phase 17. Needs PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_WRITE.

tags.name: CustomerTaxProfileService
tags.description:
CustomerTaxProfileService manages a customer's tax profiles (FR-CUS-07).
Reads need PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_READ, changes PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_WRITE.

tags.name: VehicleService
tags.description:
VehicleService manages vehicles (FRD 3.4). Filter by customer with
?customerId=. Reads need PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_READ, changes
PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_WRITE.

tags.name: CustomerPortalService
tags.description:
CustomerPortalService is the Customer BFF (Release 2.4, HLD Section 6).
The caller is a VietGara user -- in Release 2.4 created by Google
sign-in (FR-CAPP-01) -- matched to garages' customer records by its
verified e-mail. It never reads garage data beyond those records, their
vehicles and the vehicles' history.

tags.name: ReportingService
tags.description:
ReportingService serves the revenue-by-period report (FR-RPT-01) that
backs the Web Admin Dashboard's KPI card and revenue chart (UI Design
Spec 3.1). It owns no tables of its own -- revenue is aggregated fresh
from Billing & Settlement's settlements on every request, the same
cross-module decoupling pattern used everywhere else (HLD Section 2).
Every other Dashboard KPI (orders in progress, low stock, outstanding
receivables) is served by each owning module's existing list endpoint;
this is the one figure not already exposed anywhere.

tags.name: DocumentService
tags.description:
DocumentService renders PDFs and Excel reports on request (FRD 3.13).
Every document is generated fresh from the owning module's own data, read
through a narrow interface the same way every other cross-module read
works (HLD Section 2: a module never queries another module's tables
directly), with a built-in template per document type, paper size and
version (Release 10.0; a garage designing its own templates is FR-DOC-03,
Phase 14). Each RPC needs the same
permission as the data it renders (quote.read, billing.read,
inventory.read), not a permission of its own.

tags.name: FileService
tags.description:
FileService is the garage's file registry. Uploading, reading and
deleting a file need the write or read permission of the module that owns
the entity the file belongs to (e.g. garage.write for a logo).

tags.name: UserService
tags.description: UserService manages the signed-in user's own profile.

tags.name: AuthService
tags.description:
AuthService handles sign-up, sign-in, sessions, e-mail verification and
password reset (FRD 3.1). Google sign-in uses the OAuth redirect routes
GET /api/v1/auth/google/login and /callback, which are plain HTTP handlers.

tags.name: MfaService
tags.description:
MfaService lets a signed-in user manage their own TOTP second factor
(FR-IAM-09, NFR-SE-04). MFA is optional for every user and applies only to
e-mail and password sign-in. Resetting a password does not disable it.

tags.name: ImportService
tags.description:
ImportService reads Excel files into parts, goods receipts and stock
counts (FR-INV-14). The permission depends on the type: parts need
PERMISSION_CATALOGUE_WRITE, plus PERMISSION_INVENTORY_WRITE and
PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ when rows carry an opening quantity or
cost; goods receipts need PERMISSION_INVENTORY_WRITE (and cost read for
unit costs); stock counts need PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COUNT.

tags.name: InventoryService
tags.description:
InventoryService manages how many of each part a garage has (FRD 3.7).
Reads need PERMISSION_INVENTORY_READ, changes PERMISSION_INVENTORY_WRITE
(stock counts need PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COUNT, write-offs, supplier
returns and repair order part returns PERMISSION_INVENTORY_ADJUST).
The parts themselves are managed by CatalogueService.

tags.name: LicenseService
tags.description: LicenseService is the garage-facing side of License Management.

tags.name: LicenseAdminService
tags.description: LicenseAdminService is for platform admins only (FR-LIC-05, FR-LIC-08, FR-LIC-10).

tags.name: PlatformStaffService
tags.description:
PlatformStaffService manages platform roles, platform staff groups and
their members (FR-IAM-10). Every call needs PLATFORM_PERMISSION_PLATFORM_
STAFF_READ (reads) or PLATFORM_PERMISSION_PLATFORM_STAFF_WRITE (changes);
a Platform Admin passes. A user without the Platform Admin right can only
give permissions they hold themselves.

tags.name: PlatformAccessService
tags.description:
PlatformAccessService is the signed-in user's own side of platform access:
what they may do, and the invitations they received. It needs no platform
permission, so a user about to become admin staff can answer an invitation.

tags.name: QuoteService
tags.description:
QuoteService manages quotes (FRD 3.5). Reads need PERMISSION_QUOTE_READ,
changes PERMISSION_QUOTE_WRITE.

tags.name: PublicQuoteService
tags.description:
PublicQuoteService serves the customer-facing approval link (FR-QUO-02),
reachable with no access token: the token in the path is the
authorization (Security Architecture Section 2, public link pattern).

tags.name: RepairOrderService
tags.description:
RepairOrderService manages repair orders (FRD 3.6). Reads need
PERMISSION_REPAIR_ORDER_READ, changes PERMISSION_REPAIR_ORDER_WRITE.

tags.name: SupplierService
tags.description:
SupplierService manages the garage's suppliers (FR-SUP-01). Reads need
PERMISSION_SUPPLIER_READ, changes PERMISSION_SUPPLIER_WRITE.

tags.name: SupportService
tags.description:
SupportService is the platform side of support access (FR-IAM-11): admin
staff request a grant, see their grants, end a session and use the
diagnostic views of a garage they hold a grant for. Garage data itself is
read through the ordinary read endpoints of the garage; with an active
grant they answer, read-only, to the staff member.

tags.name: GarageSupportService
tags.description:
GarageSupportService is the owner's side of support access: approve or
decline requests, revoke a grant at once and read what support opened.
Every call is for the garage owner only, and stays reachable when the
subscription is locked.

tags.name: TechnicianService
tags.description:
TechnicianService is the Technician BFF (Release 2.2, HLD Section 6): one
consolidated call per screen of the Technician App, composed from the
Tenant and Repair Order modules, so the app never calls each garage's
endpoints one by one.

tags.name: RoleService
tags.description:
RoleService lets a garage owner manage the roles shared by their garages.
Every call acts on the signed-in owner's own roles.

tags.name: StaffGroupService
tags.description:
StaffGroupService manages a garage's staff groups. Listing needs
PERMISSION_STAFF_READ; changes are owner-only.

tags.name: GarageService
tags.description: GarageService manages garages (FRD 3.2).

tags.name: InvitationService
tags.description:
InvitationService handles staff invitations: the garage side needs
PERMISSION_STAFF_WRITE; the /me side is the invited user.

tags.name: StaffService
tags.description:
StaffService manages a garage's members. Reads need
PERMISSION_STAFF_READ, changes PERMISSION_STAFF_WRITE. Members join
through InvitationService.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
- REPAIR_ORDER_STATUS_OPEN: "To Do": not yet started.
 - REPAIR_ORDER_STATUS_WAITING_ON_PARTS: Blocked on a part not currently in stock (Release 7.3): set when the
draft stock issue cannot be covered by what is on hand, cleared when
it can.
 - REPAIR_ORDER_STATUS_COMPLETED: Every line is done; ready for the advisor to close it.
 - REPAIR_ORDER_STATUS_CLOSED: Closed (FR-REP-06): no further edits; ready for settlement (Release
1.4) and triggers stock deduction (Event Design, repair_order.closed).
 - REPAIR_ORDER_STATUS_CANCELLED: Cancelled before any work started (Release 7.3): its stock issue is
cancelled and the reservation released. Final.

Cancels a repair order that is open or waiting on parts (Release 7.3):

came from stays converted. FAILED_PRECONDITION once work has started,
or when the order is completed, closed or already cancelled.

Closes the repair order (FR-REP-06): fails FAILED_PRECONDITION
unless every line is completed. Publishes repair_order.closed, which
deducts stock for the part lines (Event Design).

Adds a line to a repair order that is not closed or cancelled
(Release 7.3). The draft stock issue follows a part line. Once the
stock issue is posted, a part line can no longer be added.

Removes a line from a repair order that is not closed or cancelled
(Release 7.3); the last line cannot be removed. A part line cannot be
removed once the stock issue is posted (FAILED_PRECONDITION).

overall status (the Kanban column) is derived from its lines and
returned in the response. A part line's item, quantity and unit are
fixed once the stock issue is posted.

order's lines), and the total returned from a line cannot exceed what

parameters.name: refType
parameters.description:
Release 7.1: only movements caused by this kind of document.

 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_PURCHASE: A manual stock receipt from a supplier (FR-INV-01). Superseded in
Release 7.0 by GOODS_RECEIPT, kept for movements recorded before it.
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_REPAIR_ORDER: Automatic deduction when a repair order with part lines closes
(FR-INV-02). Superseded in Release 7.0 by STOCK_ISSUE.
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_GOODS_RECEIPT: A completed goods receipt document (FR-INV-06, Release 7.0).
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_STOCK_ISSUE: A posted stock issue document (phiếu xuất kho, FR-INV-20, Release 7.0).
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_STOCK_COUNT: A completed stock count: the adjustment that makes stock equal the
count, or the reversal of a cancelled count (FR-INV-12, Release 7.1).
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_WRITE_OFF: A write-off document, or the reversal of a cancelled one (FR-INV-09,
Release 7.1).
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_SUPPLIER_RETURN: A return to supplier document, or the reversal of a cancelled one
(FR-INV-10, Release 7.1).
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_REPAIR_ORDER_RETURN: Unused parts returned from a repair order (FR-INV-11, Release 7.1);
ref_id is the repair order part return.

@type.description:
A URL/resource name that uniquely identifies the type of the serialized
protocol buffer message. This string must contain at least
one "/" character. The last segment of the URL's path must represent
the fully qualified name of the type (as in
`path/google.protobuf.Duration`). The name should be in a canonical form
(e.g., leading "." is not accepted).

In practice, teams usually precompile into the binary all types that they
expect it to use in the context of Any. However, for URLs which use the
scheme `http`, `https`, or no scheme, one can optionally set up a type
server that maps type URLs to message definitions as follows:

* If no scheme is provided, `https` is assumed.
* An HTTP GET on the URL must yield a [google.protobuf.Type][]
  value in binary format, or produce an error.
* Applications are allowed to cache lookup results based on the
  URL, or have them precompiled into a binary to avoid any
  lookup. Therefore, binary compatibility needs to be preserved
  on changes to types. (Use versioned type names to manage
  breaking changes.)

Note: this functionality is not currently available in the official
protobuf release, and it is not used for type URLs beginning with
type.googleapis.com. As of May 2023, there are no widely used type server
implementations and no plans to implement one.

Schemes other than `http`, `https` (or the empty scheme) might be
used with implementation specific semantics.

Garages the user owns or is an active member of; staff do not see
inactive garages.
Link requests waiting for an answer and the garages already linked.

One entry per garage whose customer record carries the user's
verified e-mail, by garage name.

Open repair orders (not closed) with at least one line assigned to the
technician, across every garage where they are an active member
allowed to read repair orders; oldest first.

v1ListPartCategoriesResponse.description: The whole tree as a flat list with parent ids.

v1Locale.description:
Locale is the user's interface and e-mail language. Vietnamese is the
default (NFR-US-01).

data.description: The garage's own customers matching the contact.

userExists.description:
Whether a VietGara user has this verified phone or e-mail. Nothing else
about the user is ever returned.

barcode.description: The matched code with the unit one scan stands for.

customerId.description: The garage's customer record matched to the signed-in person.

vehicles.description: The vehicles on that customer record.

v1MyGarage.description: MyGarage is a garage where the signed-in person is a customer.

platformAdmin.description: Configured in the deployment; holds every permission.

permissions.description: The effective permissions (the full catalogue for a Platform Admin).

v1MyPlatformAccess.description:
MyPlatformAccess is what the signed-in user may do on the platform: it
decides whether the admin web and the admin app open and which menus they
show.

stockIssue.description: Stock issue (phiếu xuất kho) numbers (FR-INV-20, Release 7.0).

v1NumberingTemplates.description:
NumberingTemplates configures document numbers (FR-TEN-05). Placeholders:
{YYYY}, {YY}, {MM}, {DD} and {SEQ:n} (sequence padded to n digits),
e.g. "BG-{YYYY}{MM}-{SEQ:4}".

resendAvailableAt.description: A new OTP cannot be requested before this time.

v1OtpChallenge.description: OtpChallenge tells the client how long the e-mailed OTP is valid.

factor.description: Base units in one of this unit; a decimal string above zero.

salePrice.description:
VND for one of this unit. On input it is an override; on output it is
the override or, when none is set, the part's sale_price times factor.

salePriceOverridden.description: True when sale_price is an override rather than derived.

v1PackagingUnit.description:
PackagingUnit is one non-base unit of a part with its factor to the base
unit (FR-CAT-02): 1 case = 24 cans is factor "24" when the base unit is
the can. The base unit has no row.

total.description: Total number of items matching the query, across all pages.

pageSize.description: The page size that was applied.

v1Pagination.description:
Pagination describes the page returned by every List call (API
Specification Section 1.1): lists are requested with `page` (1-based,
default 1) and `page_size` (default 20, max 100).

v1PaperSize.description:
PaperSize is the paper a document prints on: A4 (210 x 297 mm) or A5
(148 x 210 mm).

baseUnitId.description:
The unit stock, thresholds and document quantities are kept in. It
cannot change once the part has stock movements, packaging units or
document lines.

salePrice.description: What the customer pays per base unit, whole VND (FR-CAT-09).

reorderThreshold.description:
A decimal string in the base unit; the low-stock badge shows at or
below it (FR-INV-04, display half).

images.description: At most three, in display order; the first is the thumbnail.

barcodes.description:
The barcodes that identify this part, each for the base unit or a
packaging unit (FR-INV-13). Set with SetPartBarcodes.

v1Part.description: Part is one part code of a garage (FR-INV-01, FR-CAT-01..04, FR-CAT-09).

barcode.description:
1 to 64 characters, letters, digits and - . / + $ % space; stored as
typed after trimming. Matched case-insensitively, by lookup, search and
the uniqueness check alike. Unique across the garage's parts; deleting
a part frees its codes.

unitId.description:
The packaging unit one scan stands for (a case barcode); unset means
the base unit. Must be a packaging unit of the same part.

v1PartBarcode.description: PartBarcode is one scannable code of a part. Codes are unique per garage.

v1PartCategory.description:
PartCategory is one node of the category tree of at most three levels
(FR-CAT-03), e.g. Engine oil > Synthetic > 5W-30.

url.description: Public URL; the part_image kind needs no signature.

v1PartImage.description: PartImage is one image of a part (FR-CAT-04), a file of kind part_image.

supplierSku.description: The supplier's own code for the part.

lastUnitCost.description: The last cost paid per base unit, whole VND; omitted when never paid.

v1PartSupplier.description:
PartSupplier is one usual supplier of a part with the supplier's own code
and the last cost paid (FR-INV-19). One of them is the default that
pre-fills a receipt line's supplier.

contentType.description: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp or application/pdf, at most 5 MB.

v1PaymentEvidence.description: PaymentEvidence is the screenshot of the transfer.

qrUrl.description: The QR code image, a signed URL valid for 5 minutes; empty when none.

v1PaymentInstructions.description:
PaymentInstructions are the platform's payment details shown with a
payment request (FR-LIC-10).

v1PaymentMethod.description:
PaymentMethod: how a payment was actually collected (FR-BIL-03). ONLINE
is recorded manually in Release 1.4 (staff sees a bank app or gateway
dashboard confirmation and records it); automatic confirmation via a
payment gateway webhook is Release 2.0 (FR-PAY-02).

v1Permission.description:
Permission is one action a staff member may perform in a garage
(FR-IAM-03). The catalog is fixed by the platform and grouped by module,
each module offering a read and/or a write action; garage owners combine
permissions into roles. A write permission includes the read permission
of its module. Owners always hold every permission; every active member
may read the garage profile.

 - PERMISSION_GARAGE_WRITE: Edit the garage profile, configuration and logo.
 - PERMISSION_STAFF_WRITE: Invite, activate/deactivate and remove staff, and change their groups.
 - PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_READ: Customers and their vehicles.
 - PERMISSION_SUPPLIER_READ: The garage's suppliers (FR-SUP-01).
 - PERMISSION_CUSTOMER_CORRECT: Correct a locked vehicle identity field and move a vehicle to another
customer (FR-CUS-09). Held by the manager role by default.
 - PERMISSION_CATALOGUE_READ: Parts, units, packaging, categories, prices and images (Release 6.0).
 - PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ: See a part's cost, average cost and the valuation report (FR-INV-08,
Release 7.0). Held by managers and accountants by default; advisors and
technicians see quantities only.
 - PERMISSION_INVENTORY_ADJUST: Post stock adjustments other than counts: write-offs, returns to
supplier and returns of unused parts from a repair order (FR-INV-09/10/11,
Release 7.1). Held by managers and inventory staff by default.
 - PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COUNT: Create, merge, complete and cancel stock counts (FR-INV-12, Release 7.1).
Held by managers and inventory staff by default.

module.description:
Module the permission belongs to, e.g. "customer", used to group the
role editor.

action.description: "read" or "write": the permission's column in the role editor.

code.description: Unique, e.g. "pro"; "trial" is the plan every new owner starts on.

price.description: Price per billing cycle in the smallest currency unit (VND).

isActive.description: Inactive plans cannot be chosen; existing subscribers keep them.

maxStaff.description:
Staff members across all garages, excluding the owner and counting
pending invitations.

maxTransactionsPerDay.description:
Business documents (quotes, repair orders, settlements) created per
calendar day (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).

v1PlanLimits.description: PlanLimits caps usage across all garages of the subscribing owner.

v1PlanPaymentKind.description:
PlanPaymentKind says what a payment request pays for (FR-LIC-07).

 - PLAN_PAYMENT_KIND_CHANGE: Another plan.
 - PLAN_PAYMENT_KIND_RENEW: The current plan for another period.

reference.description: The code the owner puts in the transfer note, e.g. "VG-7K2M9Q".

quotedAmount.description:
New plan price, account credit applied, amount to transfer and any
surplus that becomes credit (VND, FR-LIC-09).

periodDays.description: Days of the current period and how many are unused (0 after expiry).

instructions.description: The payment details shown when the request was quoted.

payerName.description: The owner's declaration, set once submitted.

evidenceUrl.description: The evidence screenshot, a signed URL valid for 5 minutes.

amountMismatch.description: True when the transferred amount differs from amount_due.

reviewNote.description: The admin's note on approval (required when amount_mismatch).

v1PlanPaymentRequest.description:
PlanPaymentRequest is an owner's request to switch to a plan, or to renew
the current one, paid by a manual bank transfer (FR-LIC-07). The amounts
are fixed when it is quoted and honoured at approval.

v1PlanPaymentStatus.description:
PlanPaymentStatus is the state of a payment request (LLD 3.3).

 - PLAN_PAYMENT_STATUS_AWAITING_PAYMENT: Quoted, with its transfer reference; the owner has not declared the
transfer yet. A new request replaces it.
 - PLAN_PAYMENT_STATUS_SUBMITTED: The owner declared the transfer; a platform admin reviews it.
 - PLAN_PAYMENT_STATUS_APPROVED: Approved: the plan applied at once.

v1PlatformInvitation.description:
PlatformInvitation asks an existing user to join a platform staff group.
It is e-mailed to the user and expires after 7 days.

qrUrl.description: The QR code, a signed URL valid for 5 minutes; empty when none.

v1PlatformPaymentSettings.description: PlatformPaymentSettings are the details owners transfer to (FR-LIC-10).

v1PlatformPermission.description:
PlatformPermission is one action a platform user may perform (FR-IAM-10).
The catalogue is fixed and grouped by module, like the garage catalogue,
but it is a separate scope: it has no garage. A write permission includes
the read permission of its module. A Platform Admin (configured in the
deployment) holds every permission; admin staff hold the union of the
roles of their platform staff groups. Permissions are evaluated on every
request from the database, so a removal applies at once.

 - PLATFORM_PERMISSION_PLAN_READ: Plans, and the platform payment details.
 - PLATFORM_PERMISSION_SUBSCRIPTION_READ: Subscriptions, payment requests and credit.
 - PLATFORM_PERMISSION_STATS_READ: Platform dashboards (Phase 12).
 - PLATFORM_PERMISSION_GARAGE_DIRECTORY_READ: Names and owners of garages, no business data.
 - PLATFORM_PERMISSION_USER_READ: Look up a user; never password or token data.
 - PLATFORM_PERMISSION_PLATFORM_STAFF_READ: Platform roles, groups, staff and invitations.
 - PLATFORM_PERMISSION_SUPPORT_READ: Open and use support grants (Release 8.2).
 - PLATFORM_PERMISSION_AUDIT_READ: Read the platform audit log.

module.description: Module the permission belongs to, e.g. "plan": groups the role editor.

action.description: "read" or "write": the permission's column in the role editor.

groupCount.description: Number of platform staff groups using the role.

v1PlatformRole.description: PlatformRole is a named set of platform permissions.

v1PlatformStaffGroup.description:
PlatformStaffGroup is a set of users that all receive the permissions of
the group's role.

platformAdmin.description:
Configured in the deployment (PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS): holds every
permission and cannot be removed here.

v1PlatformStaffMember.description:
PlatformStaffMember is a user with platform access: a Platform Admin, or a
member of at least one platform staff group.

copyMark.description: Whether a reprint carries a "copy" mark.

availablePaperSizes.description: The sizes the document type has a template for.

v1PrintSetting.description:
PrintSetting is a garage's printing choice for one document type
(FR-DOC-04). A garage that never changed it prints on A4 without the
copy mark.

expiresAt.description: The link stops working after this time or once decided.

v1PublicQuote.description:
PublicQuote is what an unauthenticated customer sees through the
approval link: no internal identifiers, only what they need to decide.

unitCost.description: The cost per base unit, whole VND.

v1PurchaseLine.description:
PurchaseLine is one line of a completed goods receipt in the purchases
report (FR-INV-19).

number.description:
Assigned from the garage's quote numbering template (FR-TEN-05) when
the quote is first created.

approvalMode.description:
Defaults to the garage's default_quote_approval_mode; changeable while
the quote is a draft.

billingParty.description:
Who is billed (FR-CUS-07): send tax_profile_id; the snapshot of the
profile is kept on the quote and printed on its PDF.

v1Quote.description: Quote is a price estimate awaiting the customer's approval (FR-QUO-01).

v1QuoteApprovalMode.description:
QuoteApprovalMode selects how a quote is approved by the customer
(FR-QUO-02). Used by both Tenant (a garage's default, FR-TEN-05) and
Quote & Pricing (the mode of one quote), so it lives here rather than in
either module's package.

 - QUOTE_APPROVAL_MODE_LINK: A public approval link is generated; it is e-mailed to the customer
automatically when they have an e-mail on file (so they are notified
of the proposed work even if they decide over the phone), and they may
approve or reject each line online with no login.
 - QUOTE_APPROVAL_MODE_MANUAL: No link is generated or sent. A staff member records the customer's
decision directly (e.g. approved face to face at the counter), for
garages that prefer not to depend on the customer's e-mail or a link.

v1QuoteItemType.description: QuoteItemType: a quote line is either labor or a part.

itemRefId.description:
A parts-catalog reference once the Inventory module ships (Release
1.3); free text for now.

quantity.description:
Decimal string, e.g. "1" or "1.5", in the base unit of the part. When
unit_id is set the server ignores this on input and derives it from
entered_quantity (FR-CAT-02), so a line read back and sent again is
never converted twice.

unitId.description:
The packaging unit of the part the amount was entered in; unset for
labor and for base-unit lines.

enteredQuantity.description: The amount as typed, in unit_id (decimal string); required with unit_id.

jobId.description:
The job this line came from (FR-CAT-06), kept so the quote remembers its
origin; the job may since have been deactivated. The line itself is
independent of the job and stays editable.

nonBillable.description:
A hidden consumable (FR-CAT-08): a part line the customer does not see
and is not billed for, whose stock is deducted when the job is done.
Only a part line with item_ref_id can be non-billable; its unit_price
and line_total are 0 and it is left out of total_amount, the public
quote, the PDF and the approval decisions. It is carried to the repair
order when its job_id has an approved line, or when it has no job_id.

v1QuoteLine.description: QuoteLine is one labor or part line of a quote.

v1QuoteLineDecision.description:
QuoteLineDecision is the customer's decision on one line item
(FR-QUO-03), recorded either by the customer through the public link or
by a staff member on their behalf (manual approval mode).

v1QuoteStatus.description:
QuoteStatus is the lifecycle of a quote (FR-QUO-01..04).

 - QUOTE_STATUS_DRAFT: Being edited by the service advisor; not visible to the customer yet.
 - QUOTE_STATUS_SENT: A LINK-mode quote waiting on the customer's decision.
 - QUOTE_STATUS_APPROVED: At least one line was approved.
 - QUOTE_STATUS_REJECTED: Every line was rejected.
 - QUOTE_STATUS_CONVERTED: Converted into a repair order (FR-QUO-04); no further edits.

quoteId.description: Set when converted from a quote; empty for ad-hoc repair orders.

v1RepairOrder.description:
RepairOrder is a repair job for one vehicle (FR-REP-01), either
converted from an approved quote (Release 1.2's ConvertQuote) or
created directly for ad-hoc work.

v1RepairOrderItemType.description: RepairOrderItemType: a repair order line is either labor or a part.

itemRefId.description:
An Inventory item id for PART lines (FR-INV-02 stock deduction on
close needs this); free text or empty for a part not carried in
stock. Validated against the garage's items when set.

quantity.description:
Decimal string in the base unit of the part; derived from
entered_quantity when unit_id is set (same rule as a quote line).

assignedTechnicianIds.description:
Technician user ids assigned to this line (FR-REP-02); a line may
have more than one.

jobId.description: The job the line came from (Release 7.3), carried from the quote line.

nonBillable.description:
A hidden consumable (FR-CAT-08): its stock is deducted, but it is not
billed, has no price and does not hold the order back (it needs no
progress). Printed documents leave it out.

v1RepairOrderLine.description: RepairOrderLine is one labor or part line of a repair order.

v1RepairOrderLineStatus.description:
RepairOrderLineStatus is one line's own progress (FR-REP-03), tracked
separately from the repair order's overall status.

repairOrderLineId.description: The repair order part line the parts are returned from.

unitId.description: The packaging unit the quantity is typed in; unset means the base unit.

reason.description: Why the parts came back; required.

unitCost.description:
The cost per base unit the parts are restored at (the line's cost
snapshot), whole VND; omitted without PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

v1RepairOrderPartReturn.description:
RepairOrderPartReturn records unused parts of a repair order coming back
to stock (FR-INV-11): the stock is restored at the cost they left with.
It is immutable. It does not change the repair order's lines or what the
customer is billed.

v1RepairOrderStatus.description:
RepairOrderStatus is the lifecycle of a repair order (FR-REP-01..06),
shown as the Kanban board's columns (UI Design Spec Section 3.3).

 - REPAIR_ORDER_STATUS_OPEN: "To Do": not yet started.
 - REPAIR_ORDER_STATUS_WAITING_ON_PARTS: Blocked on a part not currently in stock (Release 7.3): set when the
draft stock issue cannot be covered by what is on hand, cleared when
it can.
 - REPAIR_ORDER_STATUS_COMPLETED: Every line is done; ready for the advisor to close it.
 - REPAIR_ORDER_STATUS_CLOSED: Closed (FR-REP-06): no further edits; ready for settlement (Release
1.4) and triggers stock deduction (Event Design, repair_order.closed).
 - REPAIR_ORDER_STATUS_CANCELLED: Cancelled before any work started (Release 7.3): its stock issue is
cancelled and the reservation released. Final.

v1RevenuePeriod.description: RevenuePeriod is the bucket granularity of a revenue report (FR-RPT-01).

periodLabel.description:
The bucket's start, formatted for its granularity: "2026-09-30" (day),
"2026-09" (month), "2026-Q3" (quarter), "2026" (year).

v1RevenuePoint.description: RevenuePoint is one bucket of a revenue report.

isDefault.description: Created by the platform; still editable.

groupCount.description: Number of staff groups using the role.

defaultPermissions.description:
For a default role, the permissions the platform created it with: what
the role editor's "Reset to default" restores. Empty for other roles.

v1Role.description:
Role is a named set of permissions defined by a garage owner and shared
by all the owner's garages. Default roles are created when the owner
verifies their e-mail.

publicUrl.description:
The public approval URL, returned once for the advisor to copy or
share; set only for QUOTE_APPROVAL_MODE_LINK. Also e-mailed to the
customer automatically when they have an e-mail on file.

emailed.description:
Whether the e-mail above was actually sent (false: no e-mail on file,
or approval_mode is MANUAL).

mfaRequired.description: True when the sign-in is not complete: ask for the second factor.

challengeToken.description: Single-use token for VerifyMfaChallenge; valid for 5 minutes.

v1Session.description:
Session is what every successful sign-in returns. When the user has MFA
enabled and signs in with e-mail and password, the sign-in answers with
mfa_required = true and a challenge_token instead of tokens (access_token
and refresh_token are empty); the client then calls VerifyMfaChallenge.
Google sign-in never asks for the second factor.

vehicleLicensePlate.description:
Denormalized from the repair order at creation, the same pattern as
the repair order's own vehicle/customer fields.

totalAmount.description: Copied from the repair order's total at creation time. Integer VND.

paidAmount.description:
Running total of the payments that are not voided (FR-BIL-03). Integer
VND.

billingParty.description: Who is billed, kept as a snapshot (FR-CUS-07).

invoiceRequested.description:
The customer asked for a VAT invoice; only possible while the billing
party's profile is complete, otherwise INVOICE_DATA_INCOMPLETE. When
false the document is a retail receipt.

v1Settlement.description:
Settlement is the final bill of a closed repair order (FR-BIL-01),
paid by the customer. FR-REC-01's receivables view is this same list
filtered to not yet fully paid (ListSettlementsRequest.outstanding_only)
-- Release 1.4 has no separate receivables table; one arrives with
Release 2.2's reminders and reconciliation, which need their own
persisted state.

voucherNumber.description: Numbered from the garage's payment voucher template (FR-BIL-05).

payerName.description: Who paid: the billing party's name, or the customer's.

reason.description: Reason for payment printed on the voucher.

collectorName.description: The staff member who collected the money.

voided.description:
A voided voucher stays on file and no longer counts towards paid_amount
(FR-BIL-06).

v1SettlementPayment.description:
SettlementPayment is one payment recorded against a settlement
(FR-BIL-03); a settlement may receive several. The customer is the only
payer. Every payment is a payment voucher (phiếu thu, FR-BIL-05).

v1SettlementStatus.description:
SettlementStatus is a settlement's collection status, derived from the
amounts actually paid against the total (FR-BIL-01..03).

 - SETTLEMENT_STATUS_PENDING: Nothing collected yet.
 - SETTLEMENT_STATUS_PARTIALLY_PAID: Some, but not all, of the total collected.
 - SETTLEMENT_STATUS_PAID: The full total collected.

idToken.description: The ID token (a JWT) returned by Google Sign-In on the device.

locale.description: The UI language of a newly created user; defaults to Vietnamese.

owner.description: The garage owner; cannot be deactivated, removed or grouped.

groupIds.description: Staff groups of this garage the member belongs to.

permissions.description: Union of the permissions of the member's groups.

v1Staff.description: Staff is a user's membership of a garage (FR-TEN-04).

v1StaffCandidate.description: StaffCandidate is an existing user found by e-mail or phone.

v1StaffGroup.description:
StaffGroup is a set of staff in one garage that all receive the
permissions of the group's role.

v1StaffStatus.description: StaffStatus: inactive staff keep their record but lose access.

linkToken.description: The ticket for the Google popup's `link` query parameter.

number.description: Rendered from the garage's stock_count numbering template (FR-TEN-05).

name.description: A label for the people counting, for example "Shelf A".

uncountedLines.description: How many lines are in each result; included in list answers too.

totalDifferenceValue.description:
Sum of the lines' difference_value, whole VND, signed. Omitted without
PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

v1StockCount.description: StockCount is a numbered stock count document (FR-INV-12).

unitId.description:
The packaging unit the counted quantity was typed in; unset means the
base unit.

enteredCountedQuantity.description:
The counted quantity as typed, in unit_id (or the base unit). Empty
means not counted yet; "0" is a real count of none.

countedQuantity.description: The counted quantity in the base unit, derived; empty while uncounted.

systemQuantity.description: The stock on hand in the base unit when the line was last counted.

differenceQuantity.description:
counted_quantity minus system_quantity, base unit, signed (for example
"-2"); empty while uncounted.

averageCost.description:
The weighted-average cost per base unit the difference is valued at,
whole VND: the live average while a draft, the value used at completion
afterwards. Omitted without PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

differenceValue.description:
difference_quantity times average_cost, whole VND, signed (a shortage is
negative); omitted without PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

countedAt.description: When the counted quantity was last typed.

v1StockCountLine.description:
StockCountLine is one part of a stock count. system_quantity is a
snapshot of the stock on hand taken when the line is added and again each
time the counted quantity is typed ("the system quantity at the time of
counting"); completing the count takes a final snapshot of every counted
line, so that stock equals the count afterwards.

v1StockCountLineResult.description:
StockCountLineResult compares a line's counted quantity with the system
quantity.

 - STOCK_COUNT_LINE_RESULT_UNCOUNTED: No counted quantity typed yet.
 - STOCK_COUNT_LINE_RESULT_MATCHED: Counted equals the system quantity.
 - STOCK_COUNT_LINE_RESULT_OVER: Counted is more than the system quantity.
 - STOCK_COUNT_LINE_RESULT_SHORT: Counted is less than the system quantity.

v1StockCountStatus.description:
StockCountStatus is the lifecycle of a stock count (FR-INV-12): a draft
is counted line by line and can be merged with other drafts; completing it
posts the adjustments and freezes it; cancelling a draft just closes it,
cancelling a completed count posts the reversal.

number.description: Rendered from the garage's stock_issue numbering template (FR-TEN-05).

isShort.description:
Release 7.3: true while a draft cannot be covered by the stock on hand
(some line has a short_quantity); the repair order is then waiting on
parts.

v1StockIssue.description:
StockIssue is the numbered stock-out document of a repair order
(FR-INV-20). It is created as a draft with the repair order and follows
it until posted; printing it uses the standard document layout.

quantity.description: The base-unit amount posted on the issue.

unitCost.description:
The cost snapshot per base unit, whole VND; omitted without
PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

returnedQuantity.description:
Release 7.1: the base-unit amount already returned to stock from this
line (FR-INV-11); what can still be returned is quantity minus this.

shortQuantity.description:
Release 7.3: the base-unit amount of this line the stock cannot cover
yet ("0" when covered). Reservations are served in the order the issues
were created.

v1StockIssueLine.description:
StockIssueLine is one part line of a stock issue, derived from the
matching part line of the repair order while it is a draft.

v1StockIssueMode.description:
StockIssueMode is when a repair order's draft stock issue posts
(FR-INV-20): on close by default, or when the order starts.

v1StockIssueStatus.description:
StockIssueStatus is the lifecycle of a stock issue document (phiếu xuất
kho, FR-INV-20): a draft follows its repair order (the draft is the
reservation), then it is posted (stock movements written) or cancelled.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL of the first image, empty when the part has none.

quantityOnHand.description:
Decimal string in the base unit; derived from stock_transactions, never
written directly (FR-INV-03).

reorderThreshold.description: Decimal string in the base unit.

lowStock.description: True at or below the reorder threshold.

quantityReserved.description:
Decimal string in the base unit held by the part's draft stock issues
(Release 7.0, FR-INV-20): on hand minus this is what a new order can
reserve.

quantityAvailable.description: quantity_on_hand minus quantity_reserved, in the base unit.

averageCost.description:
Weighted-average cost per base unit, whole VND, rounded for display
(FR-INV-07). Omitted from answers when the caller lacks
PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

stockValue.description:
average_cost times quantity_on_hand, whole VND. Omitted without
PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

v1StockLevel.description:
StockLevel is one part with how many of it the garage has (FR-INV-03).
The part itself (SKU, name, units, category, brand, price, images) is
owned by the Catalogue module (vietgara.catalogue.v1); this is the
stock-on-hand view that joins it with the balance.

quantity.description: Decimal string, always positive; type says the direction.

unitCost.description: Integer VND; set on IN transactions from a purchase.

refId.description: The repair order id, for an OUT transaction caused by one.

unitId.description:
Release 6.0: the packaging unit the user entered and the typed amount;
`quantity` stays the base-unit amount. Empty when the base unit was used.

unitAbbreviation.description: The abbreviation of the entered unit; empty when the base unit was used.

baseUnitAbbreviation.description: The abbreviation of the part's base unit, the unit `quantity` is in.

refNumber.description:
Release 7.1: the number of the document behind the movement (goods
receipt, stock issue, stock count, write-off or supplier return); empty
for a repair order part return and for movements without a document.

reason.description:
Release 7.1: why the movement happened, for adjustments (the write-off
reason, the repair order return reason; empty otherwise).

createdByName.description:
Release 7.1: the user who caused the movement; empty for system
movements (an automatic posting).

quantityAfter.description:
Release 7.1: the part's quantity on hand right after the movement, in
the base unit (the running balance of the stock card).

v1StockTransaction.description: StockTransaction is one recorded stock movement.

v1StockTransactionRefType.description:
StockTransactionRefType names what caused a stock movement.

 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_PURCHASE: A manual stock receipt from a supplier (FR-INV-01). Superseded in
Release 7.0 by GOODS_RECEIPT, kept for movements recorded before it.
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_REPAIR_ORDER: Automatic deduction when a repair order with part lines closes
(FR-INV-02). Superseded in Release 7.0 by STOCK_ISSUE.
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_GOODS_RECEIPT: A completed goods receipt document (FR-INV-06, Release 7.0).
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_STOCK_ISSUE: A posted stock issue document (phiếu xuất kho, FR-INV-20, Release 7.0).
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_STOCK_COUNT: A completed stock count: the adjustment that makes stock equal the
count, or the reversal of a cancelled count (FR-INV-12, Release 7.1).
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_WRITE_OFF: A write-off document, or the reversal of a cancelled one (FR-INV-09,
Release 7.1).
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_SUPPLIER_RETURN: A return to supplier document, or the reversal of a cancelled one
(FR-INV-10, Release 7.1).
 - STOCK_TRANSACTION_REF_TYPE_REPAIR_ORDER_RETURN: Unused parts returned from a repair order (FR-INV-11, Release 7.1);
ref_id is the repair order part return.

v1StockTransactionType.description: StockTransactionType: a movement either adds to stock or removes from it.

v1StockValuationCategory.description: StockValuationCategory is one category's total value.

averageCost.description: The weighted-average cost per base unit, whole VND.

v1StockValuationLine.description:
StockValuationLine is one part's quantity and value at a date
(FR-INV-07). Only callers with PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ see it.

creditBalance.description: Account credit in VND (FR-LIC-09), applied to the next payment.

periodPaidAmount.description:
What was paid for the current period (0 for a trial); the basis of the
credit when the plan is changed.

openRequest.description: The request awaiting payment or review, unset when none.

v1Subscription.description:
Subscription belongs to an owner user and covers all their garages
(FR-LIC-01..04).

v1SubscriptionStatus.description:
SubscriptionStatus (LLD 3.1): past_due is read-only during the grace
period, suspended and cancelled are locked.

v1SubscriptionSummary.description: SubscriptionSummary is one row of the platform admin's subscription list.

isActive.description: False once the supplier was deactivated instead of deleted (FR-CAT-07).

v1Supplier.description:
Supplier is a business that sells parts to the garage, kept in the
garage's directory (FR-SUP-01). It is not a customer; insurers are not
suppliers either and come back in their own record in Phase 17.

number.description: Rendered from the garage's supplier_return numbering template.

goodsReceiptId.description: The completed goods receipt the parts came from, when known.

creditNoteNumber.description: The supplier's own credit note number, when they have issued one.

creditAmount.description:
The credit recorded against the supplier: the sum of the lines'
amounts, whole VND. Omitted without PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

unitCost.description:
The credit the supplier gives, VND per entered unit, as typed. Zero or
unset takes the cost of the same part on the linked goods receipt when
there is one, else the part's average cost. Omitted from answers, and
ignored on input, without PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

lineAmount.description:
entered_quantity times unit_cost, whole VND, rounded half-up per line.
Omitted without PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

v1SupplierReturnLine.description: SupplierReturnLine is one part of a return to a supplier.

entityId.description: Id from the request; empty for a list.

v1SupportAccessEvent.description:
SupportAccessEvent is one read made under a grant: the call and the entity
it named. Shown to the owner in the Support access log.

ttlHours.description: Length of the session in hours, counted from the approval.

approvedByName.description: Empty when a Platform Admin opened the garage.

grantedByPlatformAdmin.description: The grant needed no approval because a Platform Admin opened it.

v1SupportGrant.description:
SupportGrant lets one admin staff member read one garage's data, read-only,
for a limited time (FR-IAM-11). The garage owner approves it; a Platform
Admin's grant is active at once and only notifies the owner.

v1SupportGrantStatus.description:
SupportGrantStatus is derived from the grant's times, never stored.

 - SUPPORT_GRANT_STATUS_PENDING: Requested; waiting for the garage owner (a request lapses after 7 days).
 - SUPPORT_GRANT_STATUS_ACTIVE: Approved and not yet expired or revoked: the staff member can read.
 - SUPPORT_GRANT_STATUS_EXPIRED: The time ran out, before or after approval.
 - SUPPORT_GRANT_STATUS_REVOKED: Revoked by the owner (or declined while pending), or ended by the staff.

v1SupportNotification.description:
SupportNotification is one entry of the notification log of the garage's
people (owner and staff).

v1SupportOutboxEvent.description: SupportOutboxEvent is the delivery status of one event of the garage.

v1TaxProfileKind.description:
TaxProfileKind: a customer has at most one personal tax profile and any
number of company tax profiles (FR-CUS-07).

v1Unit.description:
Unit is one unit of measure of a garage (FR-CAT-01). A unit is per
garage; the factor between two units lives on the part, not here.

session.description: A new session: every other one of the user was revoked.

contentType.description: image/png, image/jpeg or image/webp, at most 1 MB.

v1Usage.description: Usage is the owner's current consumption of the plan limits.

phone.description: Optional contact phone, unique across users; used to look staff up.

emailVerified.description:
False until the e-mail OTP is confirmed; unverified users cannot use
garage, staff or business APIs.

mfaEnabled.description: True when the user has turned on a TOTP second factor (FR-IAM-09).

googleLinked.description:
True when a Google account is linked: by signing in with Google or by
LinkGoogle (FR-IAM-06).

hasPassword.description:
True when the user can sign in with a password. A user created by Google
has none until it resets one.

v1User.description: User is a person who can sign in to VietGara.

v1UserStatus.description: UserStatus is the lifecycle of a VietGara user (Database Design 2.1).

licensePlate.description: Unique per garage (ignoring punctuation and case).

isActive.description: False once the vehicle was deactivated instead of deleted (FR-CAT-07).

editable.description:
False while a live quote, repair order, settlement, booking or claim
refers to the vehicle: its identity fields are then locked.

lockedFields.description:
The identity fields that cannot be edited now (empty when editable).
Colour, notes and odometer are never locked.

v1Vehicle.description: Vehicle belongs to one customer of the garage (FR-CUS-02).

status.description: The status string of the originating entity (e.g. a QuoteStatus name).

v1VehicleHistoryEntry.description:
VehicleHistoryEntry is one quote, repair order or settlement of a
vehicle, newest first (FR-CUS-03).

v1VehicleHistoryEntryType.description:
VehicleHistoryEntryType names which module produced a history entry
(FR-CUS-03). Repair order and settlement entries appear once those
modules ship (Releases 1.3, 1.4); only QUOTE is produced today.

v1VehicleIdentityField.description:
VehicleIdentityField names a field that identifies a vehicle (FR-CUS-02).
These fields are locked while a live document refers to the vehicle; a
locked field is changed by a correction (FR-CUS-09).

 - VEHICLE_IDENTITY_FIELD_VIN: The chassis number.

refreshToken.description:
The refresh token of the current session; it is rotated so the new
session carries the verified claim.

code.description: A 6-digit TOTP code, or a recovery code (which works once).

number.description: The repair order's own document number.

lines.description: Only the lines assigned to the technician, in the order's line order.

v1WorkOrder.description:
WorkOrder is a repair order with the lines assigned to the signed-in
technician (FR-TAPP-01).

number.description: Rendered from the garage's write_off numbering template (FR-TEN-05).

totalValue.description:
Sum of the lines' value, whole VND. Omitted without
PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

v1WriteOff.description:
WriteOff is a numbered document that reduces stock at average cost
(FR-INV-09). It is posted when created; mistakes are undone by cancelling
it, which puts the parts back.

unitId.description: The packaging unit the quantity is typed in; unset means the base unit.

enteredQuantity.description: In unit_id, or the base unit; must be positive.

unitCost.description:
The average cost per base unit at the moment of the write-off, whole
VND. Omitted without PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

lineValue.description:
quantity times unit_cost, whole VND. Omitted without
PERMISSION_INVENTORY_COST_READ.

v1WriteOffLine.description: WriteOffLine is one part of a write-off.

v1WriteOffReason.description: WriteOffReason is why stock is written off (FR-INV-09).

bearer.description: Access token issued by the auth endpoints: `Bearer <token>`.
bearer.name: Authorization
